findings.issue: BackupManager.GetBackupPath() creates backups in wrong location for levels in subdirectories. When a level is at 'mods/levels/MyWeek/MyLevel.fnmm', the backup is created at 'mods/levels/Backups/MyLevel/original.fnmm' instead of 'mods/Backups/MyLevel/original.fnmm'. This breaks the backup system for nested levels (which FreeplayMenu explicitly supports via SearchOption.AllDirectories) and causes name collisions when multiple levels have the same filename in different folders.
